# Support

Japanese version is available at [SUPPORT.ja.md](/D:/Source/Self/license/.github/SUPPORT.ja.md).

## Scope

This document covers non-security support for this repository.

For security vulnerabilities, use [SECURITY.md](D:/Source/Self/license/SECURITY.md).

## How to get help

- usage questions: open a GitHub issue with the scenario, expected behavior, and current result
- bug reports: open a GitHub issue with environment details and a minimal reproduction
- feature requests: open a GitHub issue describing the problem being solved and the proposed direction

## Best-effort policy

This project is maintained on a voluntary, best-effort basis.
No response or fix timeline is guaranteed.

When maintainers are available, they will try to:

- acknowledge actionable reports
- clarify missing information
- provide guidance or fixes when feasible

## Out of scope

- urgent production support with guaranteed turnaround
- custom implementation work on demand
- private consulting or SLA-backed support
